mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have fair conditions at Verona City Hall with a comfortable temperature of 70 degrees.

The city has posted several important election notices regarding the November and April general elections. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing new development projects, including a site plan for Sub-Zero in the Liberty Business Park.

We have a busy schedule ahead in Verona. Enjoy live music at Bailey's Run today, check out yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow, or join one of the many trivia nights happening at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, Paddy Mac's, and The Bogey Factory later this week.
Looking at the weekly report, on October 23, officers made contact with two juveniles riding prohibited eMotos on Ashton Drive, which resulted in citations for their parents.
If you are craving something sweet, Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM, featuring Mint Explosion as today's flavor of the day.
